title: Existence of a unit comparison on flat K-flat representatives
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, $n\geq 0$, and a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$ with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{n+1}$. Use the intrinsic finite derived tensor structures, derived pullback $F$, and normalized comparison $\mu$ of [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-construction]. There exists an isomorphism $\epsilon:F(1_Y)\simeq 1_X$ between the intrinsic tensor units such that, for every flat-term K-flat cochain complex $P$ of normalized $A$-module sheaves on $Y$ [def-sfb-proetale-tensor-model], with $M=Q_Y(P)$, both $\mu_{1_Y,M}\,(\epsilon\otimes1)\,\lambda^X_{FM}=F(\lambda^Y_M)$ and $\mu_{M,1_Y}\,(1\otimes\epsilon)\,\rho^X_{FM}=F(\rho^Y_M)$ hold. Maps compose in traversal order; $\lambda,\rho$ are the intrinsic left and right unitors. The same epsilon works for every P. This asserts neither uniqueness nor the equations for arbitrary derived inputs.

proof.text: Identify each intrinsic tensor unit with the coefficient module concentrated in degree zero. Apply ringedDerived_closed_symmetric_monoidal to obtain a reference closed monoidal structure with its rank-one unit. Uniqueness of the left adjoints to the same internal Hom identifies tensoring by a fixed object in the two structures; evaluating at their units and applying the unitors gives the needed intrinsic-unit isomorphism.

Obtain the algebraic inverse image on pro-etale module sheaves. The ordinary canonical tensor comparison unit theorem gives an isomorphism from the pullback of the coefficient module to the target coefficient module. Transport it through the fixed finite realization and through the natural isomorphism commuting exact derived pullback with the degree-zero single functor. Together with the preceding unit identifications this gives an object isomorphism F(1) to 1, before any unit-law normalization.

Extend the existing associativity equation from flat K-flat triples to arbitrary derived triples. Every derived object is isomorphic to the localization of a flat K-flat complex, by the independent-coefficient K-flat resolution theorem. Convert its flatness presentation via siteSheafTensorRightIso. Naturality of the two associativity paths and cancellation along a product of three such isomorphisms establish their equality on all triples.

Put I=1_Y and U=F(I). The object isomorphism U to 1_X gives a natural isomorphism U tensor - to the identity via the left unitor, so this tensor functor is fully faithful. Lift the isomorphism mu(I,I) inverse followed by F(rho_I) followed by rho_U inverse along its isomorphism equivalence. The resulting epsilon:U to 1_X satisfies mu(I,I);(U tensor epsilon);rho_U=F(rho_I), by the map-preimage equation and cancellation of inverses.

For an arbitrary M apply associativity at (I,I,M), then postcompose by U tensor (epsilon tensor FM) and U tensor lambda_FM. Naturality of the associator in its middle variable and the target triangle identity combine the right-hand path into mu(I tensor I,M);((mu(I,I);(U tensor epsilon);rho_U) tensor FM). Insert the preceding normalized equation. Naturality of mu at (rho_I,id_M), the source triangle identity, and naturality at (id_I,lambda_M) identify the result with the path containing U tensor F(lambda_M). Cancel the common isomorphism prefix, then cancel tensoring by U using epsilon and the target left unitors. This is the left unit equation at M.

Apply associativity at (M,I,I) and postcompose by FM tensor (epsilon tensor U) and FM tensor lambda_U. The left unit equation at I, naturality of mu at (id_M,lambda_I), and the source triangle identity give mu(M tensor I,I);(F(rho_M) tensor U). Naturality at (rho_M,id_I) is the same path. On the other associativity path, middle naturality of the associator and the target triangle identity give mu(M tensor I,I);((mu(M,I);(FM tensor epsilon);rho_FM) tensor U). Cancel mu(M tensor I,I) and tensoring on the right by U, using epsilon and the right unitors. This is the right unit equation at M. Specializing both equations to Q(P) proves the requested conjunction with the same epsilon for every representative.

proof_origin.place: Ordinary rank-one pullback unit (Stacks 03EL), degree-zero exact derived transport, and elementary monoidal triangle coherence from the existing representative associativity theorem.

from.place: The clause "These actions commute with finite reduction and scalar extension to Qlb": the canonical finite tensor/pullback comparison and its unit coherence.

lean.statement:
theorem finitePullbackTensor_unit_representatives_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ)
    [hX : ∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [hY : ∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] :
    ∃ ε : (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).obj
        (finiteIntrinsicClosed l E Y n).monoidal.tensorUnit ≅
      (finiteIntrinsicClosed l E X n).monoidal.tensorUnit,
      ∀ (P : CochainComplex (normalizedDVRModules l E Y n) ℤ)
        (_hP : proEtaleFlatRepresentatives Y (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E Y n) P),
        let M := DerivedCategory.Q.obj P
        (((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY)
          (finiteIntrinsicClosed l E Y n).monoidal.tensorUnit M).hom ≫
          (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E X n).map (Prod.mkHom ε.hom (𝟙 _)) ≫
          ((finiteIntrinsicClosed l E X n).monoidal.leftUnitor
            ((finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).obj M)).hom =
          (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
            ((finiteIntrinsicClosed l E Y n).monoidal.leftUnitor M).hom) ∧
        (((@finitePullbackTensorConstruction l _ E _ _ _ X Y f n hX hY) M
          (finiteIntrinsicClosed l E Y n).monoidal.tensorUnit).hom ≫
          (finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor l E X n).map (Prod.mkHom (𝟙 _) ε.hom) ≫
          ((finiteIntrinsicClosed l E X n).monoidal.rightUnitor
            ((finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).obj M)).hom =
          (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).map
            ((finiteIntrinsicClosed l E Y n).monoidal.rightUnitor M).hom)
